fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/rotation` Discord slash command only reported the time until the next rotation. When a rotation was actively in progress (within 7 days), it gave no link to the decksite's rotation page where users can see exactly what cards are entering and leaving the format.

## What changed

In `discordbot/commands/rotation.py`:
- Added imports for `fetcher` and `rotation` from `magic`
- After building the rotation message, check `rotation.in_rotation()`; if `True`, append a link to `fetcher.decksite_url('/rotation/')` so users are directed to the full rotation details page

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected (full unit suite including discordbot tests)

Fixes #12308
fix.pr_title: Guide users to /rotation page when rotation is in progress (#12308)
